contract_creation_triggers.prompt_instruction: Inject Section 21 POPIA Data Processing Operator obligations, specifying mandatory encryption, breach notification within 24 hours, and audit rights.
Ensure the warranty clause explicitly grants a minimum 6-month (180-day) implied warranty of quality as mandated by Section 56 of the CPA. Do not allow draft inputs under 180 days.

contract_creation_triggers.act_reference: Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Act (Act 53 of 2003)
contract_creation_triggers.prompt_instruction: Insert a clause requiring the contractor/vendor to maintain and supply an annual B-BBEE Sworn Affidavit or Verification Certificate throughout the agreement tenure.

contract_creation_triggers.act_reference: Arbitration Foundation of Southern Africa (AFSA) Commercial Rules
contract_creation_triggers.prompt_instruction: Default dispute resolution to expedited AFSA arbitration in Johannesburg/Durban/Cape Town rather than high court litigation to preserve SMME cash flow.

contract_analysis_triggers.trigger_condition: Extracted warranty duration is less than 6 months or attempts to exclude statutory CPA remedies.
contract_analysis_triggers.default_issue: Clause restricts warranty below the statutory 6-month minimum under CPA Section 56, rendering it void in South Africa.
contract_analysis_triggers.suggested_redline: The Provider warrants that deliverables will be free from defects for a minimum period of six (6) months from delivery, in accordance with Section 56 of the Consumer Protection Act 68 of 2008.

contract_analysis_triggers.trigger_condition: Indemnity clause contains no financial cap or extends to indirect/consequential damages for the SMME.
contract_analysis_triggers.default_issue: Uncapped indemnity exposes the SMME to catastrophic financial liability beyond the value of the contract.
contract_analysis_triggers.suggested_redline: Each party's total aggregate liability under this Agreement shall be limited to the total fees paid or payable by the Client in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

contract_analysis_triggers.trigger_condition: Governing law specifies a foreign court (e.g., England & Wales, Delaware, Singapore).
contract_analysis_triggers.default_issue: Litigating in a foreign jurisdiction is financially prohibitive for a South African SMME.
contract_analysis_triggers.suggested_redline: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of South Africa.
